name: 60177 · South Elgin, IL
findings: ZIP 60177 (South Elgin) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60177 (South Elgin) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
